items.distractor_fact: તે જ દિવસે પડોશી શહેરનું તાપમાન {D}°C નોંધાયું.
items.gloss_en: That same day a neighboring city's temperature was recorded as {D} °C.
items.entity_note: a different city (a neighboring one) than the city in the story

items.distractor_fact: એ જ દિવસે એક હરીફ કંપનીનો શેરનો ભાવ €{D} હતો.
items.gloss_en: That same day a rival company's share price was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a different company (a rival) than the company whose share price is compared

items.distractor_fact: એ જ વિસ્તારના બીજા તળાવનું પાણીનું સ્તર {D} m હતું.
items.gloss_en: Another lake in the same area had a water level of {D} m.
items.entity_note: a different lake than the lake in the story

items.distractor_fact: એક બીજા બચત ખાતામાં આ મહિને €{D} જમા છે.
items.gloss_en: Another savings account holds €{D} deposited this month.
items.entity_note: a different savings account than the one in the story

items.distractor_fact: એક બીજા ગિફ્ટ કાર્ડમાં શરૂઆતમાં €{D} હતા.
items.gloss_en: Another gift card had €{D} on it at the start.
items.entity_note: a different gift card than the one in the story

items.distractor_fact: એક બીજા મોબાઇલ ડેટા પ્લાનમાં મહિનાની શરૂઆતમાં {D} GB હતું.
items.gloss_en: Another mobile data plan had {D} GB at the start of the month.
items.entity_note: a different mobile data plan than the one in the story

items.distractor_fact: એક પડોશી પરિવારની આ મહિનાની આવક €{D} હતી.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring household's income for the month was €{D}.
items.entity_note: a different household (a neighboring one) than the household in the story

items.distractor_fact: એ જ લીગમાં એક બીજી ટીમે એ જ સીઝનમાં {D} ગોલ કર્યા.
items.gloss_en: In the same league, another team scored {D} goals that same season.
items.entity_note: a different football team in the same league than the team in the story

items.distractor_fact: એ જ ત્રિમાસિકમાં એક બીજા નાના વેપારે €{D} નફો નોંધાવ્યો.
items.gloss_en: In the same quarter, another small business recorded €{D} in gains.
items.entity_note: a different small business than the one in the story

items.distractor_fact: એ જ સ્ટેશન પર બીજી લાઇનની એક ટ્રેનનું આગમન સમય રીડિંગ {D} min નોંધાયું.
items.gloss_en: At the same station, another train on a different line had an arrival time reading of {D} min recorded.
items.entity_note: shared-reference domain (arrival vs schedule): a different train on a different line, whose own schedule is not stated
